recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. No FHIR-2952 follow-up is needed unless Patient Care independently revisits Condition.onset semantics in a future issue.
issue_request: FHIR-2952 was Published/Persuasive with Modification for FHIR-core Condition and asked that Condition.onset[x] allow time; the PC motion changed the type from date to dateTime while preserving date-only precision.
initial_application: The change was historically applied in git commit a7d4372eee6bc082995cfca0a3028c8f3afc48c9, which changed the old Condition spreadsheet row from date | Age to dateTime | Age, updated onset wording, and added committee note [#2952]. The 2021 source rework recreated the current XML StructureDefinition with dateTime retained.
additional_context: Condition is active in source/fhir.ini. The current Condition.onset[x] StructureDefinition includes committee notes [#2952], J#42978 and allows dateTime, Age, Period, Range, and string; the Condition-onset-date SearchParameter covers dateTime and Period. Later FHIR-42978 clarified onset wording for clinical events without reversing dateTime support. FHIR-6334 separately addressed abatement[x] dateTime consistency and does not change the seed decision.
reconciliation: Published an empty no-change audit commit because the current active source already implements the requested dateTime support and no corrective source edit is needed.
